questions.question: Define management and construction management. What are the roles, relationships, and responsibilities among the three main construction project actors: Client (Owner), Consultant (Engineer), and Contractor for smooth project execution?

Explain the duties and responsibilities of a Site Engineer on a construction project. What are the purposes and legal importance of: (i) Site Order Book, (ii) Measurement Book (MB), and (iii) Muster Roll?

Explain the Critical Path Method (CPM) and Project Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT). For a given project network, calculate Early Start (ES), Early Finish (EF), Late Start (LS), Late Finish (LF), Total Float (TF), and Free Float (FF), and identify the critical path and project completion time.

Explain the concept of project time-cost trade-off (Project Crashing). Given normal duration, crash duration, normal cost, crash cost, and indirect cost per week, determine the optimum duration of the project and the corresponding minimum total cost.

How do you classify construction materials according to ABC analysis? Elaborate with a suitable example. Explain the material provisioning and inventory control process in detail, and discuss the importance of Value Engineering in construction projects.

What factors should be considered when selecting construction equipment? Discuss the merits and demerits of equipment mechanization versus labor-intensive construction. Enlist the heavy equipment used in earthwork and road construction and explain the functions of an excavator, motor grader, and roller.

What is a material handling system and why is it useful in construction work? What key factors must be considered for preparing the job layout of a construction site for a large-scale hydropower or highway project?

Differentiate between pre-qualification and post-qualification of contractors. What are the major steps involved during the preparation of bidding documents, issuance of notice, bid opening, and evaluation of tenders as per the Public Procurement Act (PPA) of Nepal?
Compare different types of construction contracts: Unit Price (Item Rate) Contract, Lump Sum Contract, Cost-Plus-Percentage/Fee Contract, and EPC/Turnkey Contracts, stating their suitability.

Explain the contractual clauses and significance of: (i) Performance Security, (ii) Mobilization Advance and its recovery, (iii) Retention Money, (iv) Liquidated Damages, (v) Defect Liability Period (DLP), and (vi) Dispute resolution through Dispute Adjudication Board (DAB) and Arbitration.

What is Total Quality Management (TQM) and Quality Assurance (QA) in construction projects? Describe Quality Control (QC) inspection and testing protocols for earthwork compaction, reinforcement steel, and structural concrete.

What are the common causes of construction site accidents? As in-charge of safety for a mega infrastructure project, what safety management plan, safety protocols, and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) would you enforce?

What is leadership? Discuss different leadership styles (autocratic, democratic/participative, and laissez-faire) and explain which style is most effective in managing construction laborers and site staff.

Define technical specification and explain its types: general specification, detailed specification, performance specification, and proprietary specification. Discuss the principles and guidelines for drafting unambiguous technical specifications.

Define valuation and explain how software tools aid engineers in valuation. A prospective investor desires to purchase 150,000 sq ft of land for developing a housing colony to sell plots at Rs. 9,000 per sq ft. With given deductions for roads/parks (30%), development costs, engineer fees, and 20% desired net profit, work out the valuation of the undeveloped land per sq ft.

Why is maintenance management important in civil engineering infrastructure? Differentiate between routine maintenance, preventive maintenance, breakdown (corrective) maintenance, and periodic rehabilitation with practical examples.
